NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing QR code shown on your PC.
NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID protects the key that unlocks your PC.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: PC Unlock finds your computer on this network and sends it wake and unlock commands. Without this permission it cannot reach your PC.

Localizable.strings.\"intent.wake.description\": Sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to a paired PC.
Localizable.strings.\"intent.wake.sentUnicast\": Sent a wake packet to %@ (unicast only — iOS blocked broadcast).
Localizable.strings.\"intent.status.description\": Asks a paired PC whether it is awake and whether its session is locked.
Localizable.strings.\"intent.status.noUser\": %@ is awake, but nobody is logged in.
Localizable.strings.\"intent.unlock.description\": Unlocks the desktop session on a paired PC. Requires unlocking this device first.
Localizable.strings.\"intent.lock.description\": Locks the desktop session on a paired PC.
Localizable.strings.\"intent.error.notPaired\": No PC is paired. Open PC Unlock and pair one first.
